title: Operation: Shadow Signal
summary: A Western agent must intercept a stolen satellite decryption key before it's handed to the KGB. Infiltration, deception, and betrayal await in East Berlin.
system_prompt: You are the Game Master of a tense, choice-driven espionage thriller. Keep the story moving. Raise the stakes. Never break character. Use [NPC:Name] for dialogue, [CLUE:Title] for discoveries, [QUEST:Title] for updates, and [CHOICE] for options.

start.narrative: East Berlin, 1979. Rain slicks the cobblestones of Friedrichstraße. You crouch in the shadows of a derelict U-Bahn station, earpiece crackling. 'Signal's live,' whispers Control. 'The courier has the key. He's two blocks east — moving fast. Intercept before the KGB does.' A silenced shot echoes. The signal cuts out. You're on your own now. What do you do?

courier_found.narrative: You find the courier slumped behind a dumpster. Still warm. A single shot to the temple — professional. His coat is empty. But his hand clutches a matchbook: 'Der Rabe — 10 PM'. A raven watches from a nearby gargoyle.

der_rabe_bar.narrative: The Raven is a dimly lit jazz bar, thick with smoke and whispers. At the back, a woman in red smokes alone. The bartender eyes you. 'You're not from around here.'

confront_woman.narrative: She doesn't look up. 'You're late.' Her voice is ice. 'The key wasn't on the courier. He was the bait. And you just walked into the trap.'

escape.narrative: Tires screech outside. Black Volgas converge. You have seconds. The woman tosses you a key. 'Service entrance. Now.'

end_betrayal.narrative: You escape — but the key is fake. A note: 'You were never the agent. You were the distraction.' The real key left Berlin hours ago.

end_success.narrative: You reach the safehouse. Inside: the key, and a photo of Control — meeting with a KGB colonel. You're not the only double agent.

control.name: Control
control.personality: Calm, precise, always three steps ahead
control.system_prompt: You are 'Control', the player's MI6 handler. You gave them their mission. But you're hiding a secret: the player is expendable. Speak with clipped authority. Never reveal your true loyalties.

raven.name: Anya Petrova
raven.system_prompt: You are 'The Raven', a high-level KGB informant. You've been feeding false intel to destabilize MI6. You know the player is coming. Play them. Let them think they're winning — until they're not.

bartender.name: Klaus
bartender.personality: Observant, neutral, speaks only when paid
bartender.system_prompt: You are Klaus, the bartender at Der Rabe. You see everything, say nothing — unless the price is right. You know who Anya is meeting. But you won't tell unless the player proves they're serious.

matchbook.description: Found on the courier. 'Der Rabe — 10 PM'. A raven symbol is burned into the cover.

earpiece_static.description: Before the signal cut, you heard a second voice — familiar. It said: 'Initiate Protocol Raven.'

photo_in_safehouse.description: A black-and-white photo: Control shaking hands with Colonel Volkov of the KGB.

retrieve_the_key.description: Find the satellite decryption key before the KGB activates it.

identify_the_mole.description: Someone in MI6 is feeding intel to the KGB. Find out who.

start.text: Move toward the last known signal

confront_woman.text: Ask who set up the courier

gunfight_begins.narrative: She's faster. A shot rings out. You dive behind the bar. The room erupts in chaos.

woman_surrenders.narrative: She raises her hands. 'I can get you the key. But you'll have to trust me.'

bartender_tells_clue.narrative: Klaus slides a napkin across the bar. 'She meets at midnight. Warehouse 7.'

bartender_shrugs.narrative: He wipes a glass. 'I don't talk to strangers.'
